paper_title: ASyMOB Algebraic Symbolic Mathematical Operations Benchmark
caption: belowskip=0pt : Effect of equivalence-type perturbations. Note the substantial drop in success rate for most models, even when performance on the seed set is high.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the success rate for several models under different equivalence-type perturbations. The horizontal axis represents the model name, with labels including “Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code),” “DeepSeek-Prover-V2,” and “GPT-4o mini,” ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Success Rate (%)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks placed at 20-unit intervals.  Each model is represented by a group of four adjacent bars, colored blue, light blue, medium blue, and dark blue, representing “Seed,” “Equivalence-One-Easy,” “Equivalence-One-Hard,” and “Equivalence-All-Hard” data respectively.  For example, the “Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code)” group shows a blue “Seed” bar reaching approximately 92%, a light blue “Equivalence-One-Easy” bar reaching approximately 86%, a medium blue “Equivalence-One-Hard” bar reaching approximately 50%, and a dark blue “Equivalence-All-Hard” bar reaching approximately 18%. The tallest bars across the chart correspond to the “Seed” data, while the shortest bars generally represent the “Equivalence-All-Hard” data, with values ranging from near zero to approximately 25% depending on the model. No bars are visibly emphasized with shading, boldness, or outlines.
